Improving the customer journey in international payments

Addressing customer experience and operating performance together.

The objective

Improve customer retention and reduce transaction abandonment in a money-transfer business.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led a digital transformation spanning customer experience, contact-centre capabilities and fraud detection. The work connected customer-facing improvements with supporting operational and technology changes.

The outcome

The CV reports $57 million in increased revenue and $18 million in cost reduction over three years, alongside improved retention and lower abandonment.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Examining a business problem across the customer journey, rather than treating service, technology and operations as separate issues.
